name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid v3 (int8, full steps)
author: Darksidewalker
note: One file that does text, first/last frame and references: MiniMax's fl2va and ref2va merged, pruned, stored in int8 ConvRot (needs a recent ComfyUI). His recommended settings, set here: res_multistep with the simple scheduler, shift 11 for the video and 4 for the sound, 24 steps (he says 20 to 25; euler/simple works too). Rechecked against his page on 5 October 2026: v3 is his newest.
